QuantMaster is catalogued as a 27 April 2025 Ethereum Mainnet incident with about $100,000 lost, but the available record does not identify the exploit transaction, contract address, or a verified postmortem. Unknown. The only available mechanism label is Backdoor Contract, and one secondary report alleges employee-implanted malicious code, but neither source provides a verified contract, transaction, or code path.
